subclasses.name: College of Chaos
subclasses.description:
Chaotic power churns inside of you. Bards of the College of Chaos harness the wild forces of chaos and creation, allowing them to perform powerful and unpredictable feats.

Yours is not a formal bardic college. Bards of Chaos are most usually expelled from other schools after setting fire to the stage or calling down accidental lightning strikes. Your performances are wild affairs, and both your music and your magic can shred the air with chaotic power.

Maybe your abilities originated after been exposed to the plane of chaos, or maybe you simply developed a penchant for raising hell. Whatever the reason, you can unleash raw, destructive power - making you a terrible threat to both enemies and allies alike.

features.name: Chaotic Rift
features.description:
At 3rd level, your magic can strike a chord against the universe, producing wild effects. Once per turn, the DM can have you roll a d20 immediately after you cast a bard spell of 1st level or higher. If you roll a 1, roll on the Chaotic Rift Table to create a instantaneous magical effect. If the effect is a spell that would normally require concentration, it doesn't require concentration and instead lasts for its full duration.

Alternatively, as a bonus action you can expend a use of your bardic inspiration to roll on the Chaotic Rift Table.

features.name: Master of Destruction
features.description:
At 6th level, you can channel destructive energy to produce ferocious spells at random. As an action, you can choose to expend a spell slot between 1st and 5th level. Depending on the level of spell slot expended, consult the Destructive Spell Table below, and roll a d4. You then cast that spell.

When you cast a spell in this way, it takes effect at one spell level higher than the spell slot you expended and you do not need to provide any material components.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to 2 plus your proficiency bonus. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Your DM may replace any spell on the Destructive Spell Table with another of their choice, provided the substitute spell is a damaging spell (preferably an evocation spell) with a casting time of one action and a duration of instantaneous.

features.name: Embrace the Chaos
features.description: From 14th level, you gain the ability to channel the forces of chaos towards a desired result. Whenever you roll on the Chaotic Rift Table, you can roll the die twice and choose which of the two effects to apply.
